text_block_list.text:
Special Week didn't show up for training, 
and I was finally able to reach her in the 
evening――

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry I couldn't make it to 
training...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Actually, Suzuka-san has a race today... I 
just couldn't resist going to watch it, so 
here I am...!!
choice_data_list:
Well, watching is a learning experience 
too.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Trainer...! Ugh, thank you so much.
choice_data_list:
Did you learn anything from Suzuka's 
running?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Veeeery! I really don't think anyone could 
ever copy that big breakaway of hers—

If "nobody can imitate it," then won't it 
be useless as a reference...? Despite 
thinking that, I listened to her story 
anyway.
